tests.tests/payment-webhook.e2e.ts: test('concurrent replay and rollback retry', async () => { const app = await startRealServerWithIsolatedPostgres(); const signed = signProviderEvent({id:'evt-42', amount:4200}); await app.db.injectOneTransactionFailure(); await app.http.post('/webhooks/payment', signed); await Promise.all([app.http.post('/webhooks/payment', signed), app.http.post('/webhooks/payment', signed)]); expect(await app.db.paymentsFor('evt-42')).toEqual([{amount:4200}]); expect(await app.db.outboxFor('evt-42')).toHaveLength(1); }); test('invalid signature has no writes', async () => { const app = await startRealServerWithIsolatedPostgres(); expect((await app.http.post('/webhooks/payment', {signature:'invalid',body:{id:'evt-bad'}})).status).toBe(401); expect(await app.db.paymentsFor('evt-bad')).toEqual([]); }); // Harness contract: real HTTP server and isolated PostgreSQL; transaction-failure injection rolls back the first transaction.
